title: Version scoring rules so old scores still verify; gate rule changes on h
summary: The goal is to let PR #129's provisional-cost rule stand while the 8 older score files still check, without editing any record. The audience is the maintainer and CI's 'the full history' job. Scores record their rules string, so the new rule becomes a new rules version. Scores written under v1 are recomputed with the v1 behaviour (a bound-only cost is not provisional), and a check on scoring changes runs against the full history before landing.

defaults_applied.how: Add unit tests for v1 and v2 recomputation; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Version the rules so any future scoring change has the same escape, instead of special-casing the 8 files.
The history check is wired into the pre-landing task, not left as prose.
Criteria run the history check over the real records and check the outcome.
A verifier runs the build and tests and the history check.
One focused change: rules versioning plus one gate wiring.
Doc comments explain the legacy-rules path to an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: PR #129's branch is the base for the work: the provisional-cost rule (cost_is_only_a_bound, cost_provisional) already exists in crates/athena-score/src/lib.rs. I only read the base tree, where that rule is partly present, so this is inferred.

Score records carry a `rules` string, now '...; v1'. The gate refuses any score whose rules differ from athena_score::RULES (crates/athena-gate/src/jobs.rs:287). The fix is to bump RULES to v2 and have the gate recompute a v1 score under v1 behaviour, where a bound-only cost is firm.

'Checked against the full history before it lands' means the local and CI pre-landing check (xtask ci) also runs `athena check --history`, or an equivalent test recomputes every committed score. The 'history' CI job already exists but runs separately and failed only after the change was written.
Edits to .github/workflows/ci.yml and athena.toml are not needed. The existing [history] exempt list is not used, because it would excuse the old commits rather than make them verify.
The three minor findings from job 60r4 (display.rs shows provisional cost as firm; kill-switch reason untested) are out of scope unless trivially adjacent.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo run -p athena-cli -- check --history` from the repository root (or the equivalent `cargo run` of the athena binary). It reports no violation for the 8 existing score files, including records/jobs/2026-10/20261013-141005-hrdp/score.json, and no record file is modified (git status shows no change under records/).

Run `cargo test` for athena-score and athena-gate. A new test shows a v1-rules score with a bound-only cost still follows from its records (cost not provisional), and a v2-rules score marks the bound-only cost provisional.
A gate test shows a score that claims the current rules but has the wrong provisional flag is still refused. The check was not loosened for current scores.
athena_score::RULES ends in v2, and the score code keeps a documented legacy path for v1 (with its rules string) so old scores recompute as they were written.

`cargo run -p xtask -- ci` now includes the full-history check, so a scoring-rules change fails locally before landing if it breaks old records. Show it by running that command, or by a test of the task's step list.
`cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy` are clean, and `cargo test` passes for the workspace.
CHANGELOG.md or the relevant design note says that a scoring-rules change must bump the rules version and keep the previous version recomputable, with the reason.

out_of_scope: Hand-editing or rewriting any file under records/
Adding the 8 commits to the [history] exempt list in athena.toml
Showing the provisional flag in the status display (crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs)
Tests for the kill-switch reason wording in job 60r4
departures: Slightly higher cost and time than the reference: the change spans the scoring and gate crates and xtask, and the verifier cold-builds and runs the full-history check.
